title: When Compressed CRPS Depends on Measurement Units: Diagnosis and an Affine-Stable Correction
description: Reproducibility package for a source-specific CRPS implementation audit. It contains an affine-standardized weighted CRPS wrapper, exact tests, temperature and precipitation validations, runtime comparisons, and the manuscript.
